description: Purchased trading goods catalog list price ₹1,00,000 subject to 10% Trade Discount on credit from vendor Metro Supplies
narration: Being goods purchased at list price ₹1,00,000 less 10% Trade Discount (Net ₹90,000)
explanation: Trade Discount (₹10,000) is deducted directly on the invoice bill; net price ₹90,000 is recorded in Purchases A/c (Trade discount is NEVER entered in ledger books).

description: Sold trading goods catalog list price ₹80,000 subject to 15% Trade Discount on credit to customer Sharma Traders
narration: Being goods sold at list price ₹80,000 less 15% Trade Discount (Net ₹68,000)
explanation: Trade Discount (₹12,000) is deducted at source; Sales A/c and Debtor A/c are debited/credited with net bill amount ₹68,000.

description: Paid cash ₹85,000 to vendor Metro Supplies in full settlement of ₹90,000 debt, receiving cash discount ₹5,000
narration: Being cash paid to creditor in full settlement after receiving prompt payment cash discount
explanation: Cash Discount IS RECORDED in accounting books as financial income: Debit Creditor Liability ₹90,000, Credit Cash Asset ₹85,000, Credit Discount Received A/c ₹5,000.

description: Received SBI Bank cheque ₹64,000 from customer Sharma Traders in full settlement of ₹68,000 debt, allowing cash discount ₹4,000
narration: Being bank cheque received from debtor and cash discount allowed in full settlement
explanation: Cash Discount IS RECORDED as financial expense: Debit Bank Asset ₹64,000, Debit Discount Allowed A/c ₹4,000, Credit Debtor Asset ₹68,000.

description: Purchased goods catalog list price ₹50,000 less 10% Trade Discount (Net ₹45,000); paid immediate cash under 5% prompt cash discount (Cash Paid ₹42,750, Discount ₹2,250)
narration: Being goods purchased at list price ₹50,000 less 10% Trade Discount (Net ₹45,000) and paid cash less 5% Cash Discount
explanation: Trade discount (₹5,000) reduces Purchases to net ₹45,000. Cash discount (5% = ₹2,250) is credited to Discount Received A/c.

description: Sold goods catalog list price ₹60,000 less 10% Trade Discount (Net ₹54,000); received immediate cash under 4% prompt cash discount (Cash Received ₹51,840, Discount ₹2,160)
narration: Being goods sold at list price ₹60,000 less 10% Trade Discount (Net ₹54,000) and cash received less 4% Cash Discount
explanation: Trade discount (₹6,000) reduces Sales to net ₹54,000. Cash discount (4% = ₹2,160) is debited to Discount Allowed A/c.

description: Purchased goods catalog list price ₹40,000 subject to 5% Trade Discount on credit (Net ₹38,000)
narration: Being goods purchased at list price ₹40,000 less 5% Trade Discount (Net ₹38,000)
explanation: Trade Discount ₹2,000 is deducted at invoice level; Net ₹38,000 is recorded.

description: Sold goods catalog list price ₹30,000 subject to 5% Trade Discount on credit (Net ₹28,500)
narration: Being goods sold at list price ₹30,000 less 5% Trade Discount (Net ₹28,500)
explanation: Trade Discount ₹1,500 is deducted at source; Net ₹28,500 is recorded.

description: Paid cash ₹19,000 to vendor Bengal Electricals in full settlement of ₹20,000 debt, receiving cash discount ₹1,000
narration: Being cash paid to creditor in full settlement after cash discount ₹1,000
explanation: Cash Discount IS RECORDED as income: Debit Creditor ₹20,000, Credit Cash ₹19,000, Credit Discount Received A/c ₹1,000.

description: Received SBI Bank cheque ₹28,500 from customer Rahul Traders in full settlement of ₹30,000 debt, allowing cash discount ₹1,500
narration: Being bank cheque received from debtor and cash discount allowed ₹1,500
explanation: Cash Discount IS RECORDED as expense: Debit Bank ₹28,500, Debit Discount Allowed ₹1,500, Credit Debtor ₹30,000.
